blocks.value: A stock chart can display prices over different periods of time. These periods are called timeframes.
Imagine This: You can view your life through a daily diary, a monthly calendar, or a yearly photo album. Each gives a different perspective. Stock charts work exactly the same way.
Common timeframes include 1 minute, 5 minutes, 15 minutes, 1 hour, 1 day, 1 week and 1 month.
A daily chart creates one candle for each trading day, while a weekly chart creates one candle for the entire week.
Long-term investors usually prefer daily or weekly charts, while traders often use shorter timeframes.

blocks.question: What is a timeframe?
choices: The period represented by one candle.
